title: IDKMesh Control Tower Run Evidence Response v0.1
description: The success envelope returned by `GET /api/v1/runs/{run_id}/evidence` (ADR-0024). `evidence_report` is the Run Evidence Report retained in the run row, returned as retained after its canonical digest was verified against `evidence_report_digest`; a mismatch is refused with 500 evidence_integrity_error and never served. `evidence` is a reserved trailing path segment (ADR-0019).
